regulator.name: European Data Protection Board and national supervisory authorities

facet_hints.personal_data: GDPR Articles 5 and 6 — principles and lawful bases.
facet_hints.special_categories: Article 9 special categories and Article 10 criminal convictions data.
facet_hints.children: Article 8 conditions for children's consent in information society services; note the member-state age variation between 13 and 16.
facet_hints.processor_terms: Article 28(3) mandatory processor contract terms — the DPA question for every vendor.
facet_hints.cross_border: Chapter V, Articles 44-49: adequacy, standard contractual clauses, derogations, and the transfer impact assessment expected after Schrems II.
facet_hints.automated_decisions: Article 22 and the right to human intervention; read with Articles 13-15 on the information to be provided about the logic involved.
facet_hints.dpia: Article 35 and the supervisory authority lists of processing requiring a DPIA.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Article 33 (72 hours to the supervisory authority) and Article 34 (to data subjects).
facet_hints.ropa: Article 30 records of processing activities and the small-organisation derogation.
facet_hints.ai_classification: AI Act: determine whether the system is prohibited, high-risk (Annex III), limited-risk with transparency duties, or minimal-risk, and whether the operator is a provider or a deployer. Confirm which obligations have entered into application on today's date, because they phase in.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search published supervisory authority decisions and EDPB binding decisions for comparable failures.

seed_obligations.title: Comply with the principles relating to processing of personal data
applies_when: processes personal data of data subjects in the EU
testable_as: storage limitation with a deletion path

seed_obligations.title: Establish a lawful basis for each processing purpose
testable_as: legitimate interests assessments where relied on

seed_obligations.title: Meet an Article 9 condition before processing special category data
applies_when: processes health, biometric, genetic, religious, political, or sexual-orientation data
testable_as: explicit consent records where relied on

seed_obligations.title: Have a processor contract containing the mandatory terms with every processor
applies_when: a third party processes personal data on your behalf, including an inference vendor

seed_obligations.title: Maintain records of processing activities
applies_when: processing is not occasional, involves special categories, or the organisation has 250+ employees
testable_as: a ROPA artifact covering purposes, categories, recipients, transfers and retention

seed_obligations.title: Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures
testable_as: encryption in transit and at rest

seed_obligations.title: Notify a personal data breach to the supervisory authority without undue delay and within 72 hours
testable_as: an incident runbook with the 72-hour clock

seed_obligations.title: Carry out a DPIA for high-risk processing
applies_when: systematic monitoring of a public area
testable_as: evidence of prior consultation where residual high risk remains

seed_obligations.title: Meet a Chapter V condition for every transfer of personal data outside the EEA
applies_when: personal data is transferred to or accessed from outside the EEA
testable_as: an adequacy decision, SCCs, or a derogation recorded per destination
a transfer impact assessment where SCCs are relied on

seed_obligations.title: Meet the conditions for solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects
applies_when: a decision is made solely by automated means and has legal or similarly significant effect
testable_as: a human review path that is real, not nominal
the ability to contest a decision

seed_obligations.title: Classify the AI system and meet the obligations attaching to that class and role
applies_when: places on the market, puts into service, or uses an AI system in the EU
